output.title: BR-04 lines are converted to the customer's currency and rounded one by one, half away from zero, with tax worked out on the rounded line @critical
output.data_choice: P-1020 bills to a SEK customer at 11.47 with tax S. It has two 0.25 h senior entries of 37.50 EUR, each converting to exactly 430.125 SEK, so half away from zero (430.13) differs from banker's rounding (430.12), and the rounded lines sum to 11,183.26 where rounding the total would give 11,183.25. Line 3 tax of 2,632.365 also lands on a half. Caveats: these figures are worked out from the catalogue, not observed. The material does not say whether a Swedish business customer with a VAT number still gets tax S 25.5%. Source 48219's P-1130 figures (line 3 as 270.00 EUR) do not match the catalogue (2.1 h x 120 = 252.00 EUR), and with catalogue data P-1130 would not expose either defect, so engineers should confirm both points.
